entry.title: Commodified Intelligence and the Devaluation of Human Labor
entry.content:
Lobsters Top | herecomesthemoon.net | discussion

AI has transitioned beyond simple pattern matching into a state of "commodified intelligence," where solving complex problems depends increasingly on raw capital and compute rather than specialized human thought. This evolution threatens to devalue intellectual labor, making white-collar professionals as replaceable as unskilled workers and centralizing economic leverage in the hands of those who own massive computational power.

This shift may lead to a bifurcated economy characterized by a divide between profit-driven, AI-generated content and human-centric projects driven by personal passion or niche excellence. In such a landscape, the author suggests that maintaining agency requires individuals to pursue difficult skills and creative endeavors for their own intrinsic value rather than for economic utility.
